onboarding.title: Set up your church
onboarding.lead: This creates your church workspace with default roles, attendance categories and service times. You can change all of them later.
onboarding.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Used in links.

locked.title: This church's subscription has ended
locked.lead: Your data is safe. Reactivate the subscription to sign back in, or contact your church administrator.

dashboard.noChange: No earlier month to compare with

people.lead: Everyone who serves. Each person shows the teams they belong to and when they joined the church.

people.teamsHint: Add or move people between teams from the team’s page.

teams.title: Teams
teams.lead: Departments, the positions in them, and who holds each one today.
teams.empty: No teams yet. Teams and positions appear here once they are created.

teams.noPositions: No positions yet. Add the first one.
teams.handOverLead: {name} steps down and the new person takes over from the same day.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.lead: Capture headcounts per service and category. Counts can be corrected later and every change is logged.

branding.logoLead: Shown beside your church name for everyone signed in.

reset.preheader: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.heading: Hi {name}, let’s reset your password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for this Ecclesia account. The link works for one hour and can be used once.

outbox.title: Email outbox
outbox.lead: Email isn’t connected yet, so messages are saved here instead of being sent. Open one to see exactly what people would receive.

security.title: Security
security.lead: Protect your account, and the church’s money, with a second step when you sign in.
security.twoFactorLead: After your password, you’ll enter a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
security.requiredForFinance: Your church requires two-step verification for finance. Turn it on to open Finance.
security.passwordHint: We ask again before changing security settings.
security.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
security.cantScan: Can’t scan? Enter this key in the app:
security.stepInstall: Install an authenticator app on your phone.
security.stepScan: Scan the QR code, or type in the key.
security.stepCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
security.wrongCode: That code didn’t work. Try the newest code in the app.
security.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
security.backupLead: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager. You won’t see them again.

gate.title: Turn on two-step verification to open Finance
gate.lead: Your church protects money with a second sign-in step. It takes two minutes with an authenticator app.

people.placeholder: Search by name or giving number

budgets.lead: Plan spending per category and see how much is left. Spending counts when a request is paid.

giving.title: Giving
giving.lead: Every gift, from cash counts, bank imports and manual entries. Gifts can’t be edited, only voided with a reason.
giving.recordLead: For EFTs, card payments or anything outside a cash count.
giving.voidLead: {gift} will no longer count in totals. It stays visible as void, with your reason.
giving.empty: No gifts in this period. Change the dates or record a gift.

counts.title: Cash counts
counts.lead: Count the offering after each service. A second person verifies before it counts.
counts.newLead: Pick the date the money was received. You can add lines right after.
counts.empty: No cash counts yet. Start one after the next service.
counts.submitHint: When you submit, someone else must verify the count before it becomes part of giving.
counts.verifyLead: Confirm you counted {total} too. The gifts are then recorded and the count is locked.
counts.returnLead: It goes back to draft so the first counter can fix it.
counts.deleteLead: The draft and its lines are removed. Nothing has been recorded yet.
counts.monthClosed: This month is closed, so the count can’t be changed.
counts.awaitingLead: {name} counted and submitted this. Someone else must check the cash and verify.
counts.needSecond: You submitted this count, so another person needs to verify it.

bank.lead: Upload a bank statement to record EFT giving. Only money in is used, and lines already imported are skipped.
bank.chooseHint: CSV or Excel export from your bank, up to 5,000 lines.

expenses.lead: Ask for money, attach quotes and receipts, and track approval and payment.
expenses.newLead: Say what it’s for and attach a quote, invoice or photo of the receipt.
expenses.noTeams: You need to lead a team before you can request payments.

fields.title: What is it for?
fields.titleHint: For example: Sound cables for Sunday service
fields.fundHint: The fund the money comes out of

expenses.attachLead: Add photos, screenshots or PDFs. Big photos are made smaller on your phone before uploading.

empty.approved: No approved requests waiting for payment.

attachments.title: Quotes and receipts
attachments.hint: Photos, screenshots or PDFs, up to 5 MB each, {max} at most.
attachments.added: {count, plural, one {# file added} other {# files added}}

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Income and expense statements for any period, ready to print or open in Excel.
reports.monthEndLead: Closing a month locks its gifts, cash counts and payments so the figures can’t change.
reports.closeLead: Gifts, counts and payments in this month can no longer be added or changed.
reports.reopenLead: Only reopen to fix a mistake. The reason is kept in the audit log.

settings.title: Finance settings
settings.lead: Controls, funds and categories for the church’s money.
settings.controlsLead: Who approves, who handles finance, and how sign-in is protected.
settings.secondApprovalHint: Requests above this amount need two different approvers. Leave empty for one.
settings.financeTeamHint: The leader of this team gets full finance access.
settings.defaultFundHint: Used for bank payments with no fund in the reference.
settings.requireTwoFactorHint: Strongly recommended. People with finance access must use an authenticator app to sign in.
settings.fundsLead: Where gifts go and where payments come from. Funds are switched off rather than deleted.
settings.codeHint: Short code used in bank references, like TITHE.
settings.deductibleHint: Gifts to this fund appear on Section 18A certificates.
settings.fundActiveHint: Switched-off funds stay in reports but can’t receive new gifts.
settings.categoriesLead: Used for payment requests and budgets.
settings.categoryActiveHint: Switched-off categories stay in reports but can’t be used for new requests.
settings.certificatesLead: Printed on tax certificates. Certificates are available once a PBO number is saved.
settings.signatoryHint: Name printed under the signature line
